Name: Witch Furniture
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Hi there! This is my first mod, which means I'm open to concrit and tips!

[b]Content:[/b]
[list]
[*]70+ new furniture items, mostly consisting of decor
[*]Taken from the witch's hut mostly, but some random items from other tilesheets that fit the theme
[*]Recoloured so as to be more visually cohesive
[*]So many pieces of decor. It's just mostly decorative
[*]Also includes some neon skulls because I thought they were fun
[/list]
You can find a Json Assets port of this mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3374?tab=files]here[/url]﻿.
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]When placing a window or a lamp, a yellow or white light respectively will be at the top left corner of your house rather than where it should be. Upon waking up the next day this should be fixed.
[/list]
[b]Warning:[/b]
[list]
[*]This is a mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]CF[/url]﻿ by platonymous! You will have to have that downloaded in order for this to work!
[/list]
If you have any suggestions for furniture that you want to see in the game let me know! I really enjoyed the process of making this and while I have some ideas I'd always welcome more!
